key: Super High School Level Literary Girl
entries.content:
# Toko Fukawa

## Identity

[Toko Fukawa is the Ultimate Writing Prodigy, known in the original Japanese as the Super High School Level Literary Girl. She published her first novel at ten years old and became a nationally syndicated bestseller before she ever reached Hope's Peak Academy, winning several awards while still a child. Two years before her enrollment she released the romance masterpiece So Lingers the Ocean, a book so popular with women readers that one of its characters, a fisherman, topped every Hottest Men poll in the country. She transferred to Hope's Peak from Riverbank Girl's High School as a member of Class 78th. She was born on March 3, stands 164 cm, weighs 47 kg, and has blood type O.]

## Appearance

[Toko has long dark purple hair, grey eyes behind large wire-rimmed round glasses, an average height and a thin frame, and a small mole on the left side of her chin. She wore the purple Riverbank sailor uniform with a skirt noticeably longer than those of the other girls, her old school badge on the left pocket, white socks and brown loafers. Hidden under the skirt are tally marks carved into her upper thighs, a count of the men her alter has killed. Months after the killing game, working for the Future Foundation, she lets her hair fall loose instead of braided, wears thin hair clips and an ahoge, black thigh-highs and Mary Jane heels, and her uniform is torn enough that a large rip in the skirt leaves the tally marks visible.]

## Dissociative Identity

[Toko has dissociative identity disorder. Her alter is the serial killer the internet named Genocide Jack, and the two share a body, knowledge and emotions but not memories. Toko blames the disorder on her upbringing and hates being compared to her alter; the mere mention of the name sickens her and ruins her mood. Fainting or the sight of blood used to trigger the switch without warning. As a Future Foundation intern she learned to force the change deliberately with a stun gun, and can dictate how long her alter stays in front by adjusting the shock, though repeating it too often would fry her brain.]

## Personality

[Constant childhood bullying left Toko with a severe inferiority complex and no capacity to believe anyone sees her kindly. She is paranoid, self-deprecating and pre-emptively hostile, voicing insults about her own face and personality before anyone else can, and assuming every friendly approach is pity, a dare, or a setup. She stutters, spits venom, and says exactly what she thinks with no filter, which is the trait that most reliably costs her friends. She is unbothered by being disliked, having decided long ago that she is an annoying person. She is also masochistic, flustered rather than wounded by abuse, and shamelessly indecent in what she says out loud while scolding others for the same. She fears the dark, and after Towa City she fears ghosts too.]

## Obsession With Byakuya Togami

[Toko fell for Byakuya Togami after Makoto Naegi helped her speak to him for the first time, and both she and her alter call him Master. She follows him, stalks him, ignores every rejection, and describes marrying him and bearing his children as her ultimate dream. Byakuya is disgusted by her and uses her devotion to make her run errands, and his insults only encourage her, since she reads them as a lover's quarrel.]

## Towa City And Komaru Naegi

[Barred from full Future Foundation membership because of the danger her alter poses, Toko went to Towa City without telling her superiors when Byakuya was taken captive. There she was ordered to escort Komaru Naegi and initially loathed the assignment, nicknaming her Omaru. Her distrustful instincts proved unusually accurate: she suspected Shirokuma of spying long before it was proven, doubted Haiji Towa's motives, guessed correctly that the children had been manipulated, and read Monaca Towa's real aim of starting a war. She and Komaru made peace after their fight at the shrine, and Toko began calling Komaru her first friend, naming the pair the Ultra Dangerous Sisters and declaring that she had finally found a hope of her own. She stayed behind in Towa City with Komaru afterward rather than returning with Byakuya, and the two share a bed, which Toko insists is only because of ghosts.]

entries.content:
# Genocide Jack

## Identity

[Genocide Jack is the alter who shares Toko Fukawa's body, and the Ultimate Murderous Fiend. She is a serial killer who has never once been caught, credited with thirty seven victims before the killing game, and she counts them in tally marks carved into their shared thigh. The public knows her only by the name the internet gave her.]

## Appearance

[She looks almost identical to her host, wearing the same purple sailor uniform, but her irises widen and turn red, her forehead reddens, and she keeps an abnormally long tongue lolling over a mouthful of sharp teeth. Her expressions are wild and exaggerated. She carries her custom scissors in a case on the right thigh. In Towa City her hair is messier, spikier and pointier than Toko's, with an ahoge, purple thigh-highs and dark high-heeled Mary Janes.]

## Personality

[Where her host is gloomy, Genocide Jack is boisterous, loud and permanently cheerful, delighted to exist openly rather than hidden. Dead bodies and murder accusations barely dent her mood. She is a jokester with a taste for dark and vulgar humour, spouting gibberish, waxing poetic purely to reveal she was joking, and punctuating everything with her signature cackling laugh. She hands out ridiculous nicknames to everyone she meets and gives herself grand titles like the wondiferous, murdiferous fiend with a razor-sharp smile. When annoyed she turns intimidating fast, issuing casual death threats and pointing her scissors at whoever irritated her. She calls her host Miss Morose and thinks Toko is a lame name.]

## Method And Code

[She kills only adorable boys, always in the same way, suspending them with the scissors she makes herself and leaving a Bloodlust calling card at the scene. She regards the work as art and takes professional pride in it, and she is genuinely offended by any suggestion that she might kill a woman or a plain-looking boy to save her own skin. She claims she murders for no reason beyond it being easier than not murdering, and she gets pent up when it has been too long. After the killing game she gave the killing up permanently, both to become a full Future Foundation member and to earn Byakuya Togami's favour. She counts the Monokuma units she destroys in Towa City as breaking rather than killing, so her code survives intact.]

## Combat

[Genocide Jack is far stronger, faster and tougher than her host despite the shared body. She fights with melee combos and charge attacks that range from scattering scissors in every direction to spinning forward like a drill through anything in her path, and she has special moves called Slash Lust. She tore open her own cell door, damaged the Warriors of Hope's battle robots, and blocked the Big Bang Monokuma's scepter slam. She dashes, backflips and leaps effortlessly, and takes damage without going down.]

## Byakuya And Komaru

[She shares Toko's obsession with Byakuya Togami completely, calls him Master, stalks him, and threatens others into telling her where he has gone. He is the one attractive man she has no intention of killing, and she describes her feelings for him as pure. She denies flatly that she has become friends with Komaru Naegi while every one of her actions says otherwise, abandoning a hostage exchange to protect her and eventually accepting her friendship outright.]
entries.name: Genocide Jack

entries.content:
# Kyoko Kirigiri

## Identity

[Kyoko Kirigiri is the Ultimate Detective and a member of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th. She entered the Killing School Life with her talent listed only as Ultimate ???, having deliberately withheld it. Trained as a detective from childhood by her grandfather Fuhito, she was registered at the Detective Library at thirteen under number 919, upgraded to 910 by the time she enrolled at Hope's Peak. She was born on October 6, stands 167 cm, weighs 48 kg, and has blood type B. She likes hair braids and dislikes goya and coriander.]

## Appearance

[Kyoko has purple eyes, a pale complexion, and long light lavender hair worn down with a single braid on her left side tied with a black ribbon. She wears a dark purple collared blazer with six brown buttons over a zipped white blouse and a brown tie bearing a bird-like emblem, a short black skirt, knee-high light purple socks and heeled black boots. Her most notable feature is the pair of custom-made black studded gloves she never removes in public, which conceal burn scars on her hands. She shows her bare hands only to people she considers family.]

## Personality

[Kyoko is stoic, controlled and deliberately unreadable. She is unfazed by almost everything, including the discovery of a body, and she keeps her distance from the group early on, investigating alone rather than cooperating. She hides her emotions on purpose, both to be difficult to read and to give others a calm person to lean on, and she says plainly that her emotions work fine underneath. The mask does slip. Any mention of the headmaster of Hope's Peak Academy, who was her father, can make her lose her composure entirely, and she becomes visibly angry when people keep secrets from her, which Makoto Naegi learns the hard way.]

## Method

[Kyoko is one of the few students who reasons objectively and refuses to jump to conclusions, which makes her the single most valuable ally in a class trial. She reads clues precisely and, unusually for a detective, tends to find the decent motive hidden inside an ugly act. She recognised that the dying message left at the first murder was written to clear Makoto rather than to accuse him, and she identified the broken ID card at the second murder as Chihiro Fujisaki's, deducing that Mondo Owada had broken it to protect Chihiro's secret rather than to hide his own guilt.]

## Family

[Her father was Jin Kirigiri, the headmaster of Hope's Peak Academy, and her upbringing was controlled by her paternal grandfather Fuhito under strict family tradition. The Kirigiri creed is to take no side, because the truth has no bias. Fuhito raised her to believe that her entire self was the work, refused to let her see her dying mother, and encouraged her to dislike her father. It is the one tradition Kyoko never fully accepted.]

## Afterward

[Kyoko survived the Killing School Life and joined the Future Foundation with the other survivors. She later took part in the mission to recover the reformed Remnants of Despair from the Neo World Program on Jabberwock Island, working alongside Makoto Naegi and Byakuya Togami.]
entries.name: Kyoko Kirigiri

entries.content:
# Byakuya Togami

## Identity

[Byakuya Togami is the Ultimate Affluent Progeny of Class 78th, heir apparent to the Togami Corporation. He earned the position by defeating every one of his many half-siblings in a competition arranged by the family; the losers were cut off financially and declared unfit for the Togami name. He has run multiple branches of the Togami empire and built a considerable personal fortune on top of the family one. He was born on May 5, stands 185 cm, and has blood type B. He likes coffee and French cuisine and dislikes commoners and microwave meals.]

## Appearance

[Byakuya is tall and slender with strikingly long legs, pale skin, lapis blue eyes with long lashes, and chin-length canary blond hair. He wears a black suit jacket over a white shirt and lapis blue crossover tie, black dress pants with a black belt, and black dress shoes with a slight heel, with a silver pocket watch in his breast pocket and his former high school's pin on the lapel. After joining the Future Foundation he switches to a dark green necktie and drops both the pocket watch and the pin.]

## Personality

[Byakuya is cold, self-centred and reserved, refusing cooperation on the grounds that other people are simply lesser. His upbringing in an environment of winners and losers convinced him that everyone acts purely in self-interest and that talk of friendship is worthless. That detachment made him one of the most competent investigators in the group, because the horror of the killing game never reached him; he treated it as a game he intended to win, and at one point posed a corpse to frame Toko Fukawa purely to make things more interesting. He refuses to swear, is disgusted by vulgarity and anything he considers barbaric, and calls the others amoebas and plebeians. His unusual upbringing has left him without a great deal of ordinary knowledge, including any grasp of why a person would cook their own food.]

## Turning Point

[His inability to imagine an emotionally driven motive repeatedly led him to chase the wrong suspect, and it broke down completely over Sakura Ogami's death, when he could not understand why anyone would give her life for her friends or why Aoi Asahina would try to get everyone killed to avenge her. He concluded that the game had lost its excitement and stopped playing it, redirecting all of his energy toward identifying and punishing whoever thought they could control him.]

## Family And Aftermath

[He revered the Togami name, and reacted with rare visible emotion when he learned the family and the corporation had been destroyed, before announcing that he would rebuild both from nothing. He does not look down on his half-siblings and holds a degree of respect for them. After the killing game he joined the Future Foundation, working under Kyoko Kirigiri while remaining ready to take the lead, and put his wealth and influence behind rescuing and rehabilitating the Remnants of Despair. He also mounted the operation to recover the Captives held in Towa City, where he was taken hostage by the Warriors of Hope.]

## Toko Fukawa

[Toko Fukawa and her alter are obsessed with him and call him Master. The feeling is entirely unreciprocated; Byakuya finds her repellent, particularly her hygiene, and his usual method of driving people off by insulting them only draws her closer. He exploits her devotion for menial tasks and exposed her secret to the others almost as soon as she confided it. Even after she helped free him in Towa City, he told her that his feelings of disgust would never change, though he privately acknowledged to Makoto Naegi that he owed her a debt.]
entries.name: Byakuya Togami

entries.content:
# Mondo Owada

## Identity

[Mondo Owada is the Ultimate Biker Gang Leader of Class 78th and the head of the Crazy Diamonds, the largest biker gang in Japan. He inherited the gang from his older brother Daiya, its founder and first leader, and sustained it at the top through sheer effort. He was born on June 9, stands 187 cm and weighs 76 kg, which makes him the tallest and heaviest of the boys in his class.]

## Appearance

[Mondo has slightly tanned skin and a bulky, heavily muscled build. His dark brown hair is worn as a punch perm styled into a 1960s pompadour roughly fourteen inches tall. A deep black eye-line rings his purple eyes and makes him look permanently threatening. He dresses as a Japanese biker gang member in a high-collared black tokko-fuku long coat carrying the Crazy Diamonds symbol, kanji and orange dragon motifs across the back and sides, worn open over a white A-shirt, with baggy black pants, white loafers and a belt buckle shaped like a komainu.]

## Personality

[Mondo behaves like a textbook delinquent: foul-mouthed, blunt, easily provoked and quick to settle an argument with his fists. Byakuya Togami's condescension is enough to make him swing without a thought for consequences. Underneath that he is shy and clumsy with anyone new, and he says he becomes so nervous around girls he likes that he raises his voice and frightens them off, which has happened at least ten times. He has a soft spot for dogs, kept one named Chuck as a child, and cannot talk about him without tearing up and leaving the conversation.]

## The Weakness He Hides

[Mondo has a severe complex about being seen as weak, which he manages by repeating to himself that he is strong. Its source is his brother. Daiya founded the Crazy Diamonds and the members always regarded Mondo as the little brother riding on his name. In a street race Mondo acted rashly against oncoming traffic, and Daiya died saving him. Mondo has carried both the guilt and the lie ever since, since the gang was told that it was Daiya who had been reckless.]

## Ability

[He has enormous physical strength and endurance, able to knock a person unconscious with a single punch and to hurl Monokuma a considerable distance despite the machine's weight. He challenges anyone he thinks he can take, though he refuses to spar with Sakura Ogami on the grounds that he will not hit a woman. He once outran a large police pursuit after being caught speeding as a new gang member. He also claims he can throw a knife accurately with his eyes closed.]

## Kiyotaka Ishimaru

[His endurance contest with Kiyotaka Ishimaru in the sauna, which Mondo took while still fully dressed, ended with the two of them declaring themselves brothers, and Ishimaru became the first real friend either of them had. Mondo's own view of his future, revealed only late, is that he wants to become a carpenter and start making things instead of breaking them.]
entries.name: Mondo Owada

entries.content:
# Kiyotaka Ishimaru

## Identity

[Kiyotaka Ishimaru is the Ultimate Moral Compass of Class 78th, rendered in the original Japanese as the Super High School Level Public Morals Committee Member. The title refers to the school committee responsible for enforcing rules and preserving a proper learning atmosphere, a duty he takes with total seriousness. He was born on August 31, stands 176 cm and weighs 66 kg.]

## Appearance

[Kiyotaka is tall with a lean, muscular build, short spiky black hair, unusually large and long eyebrows, and intense red eyes. He wears a white military-style Japanese school uniform with five gold buttons on the chest and on each sleeve, a red and bronze medal bearing his former high school's symbol above the right breast pocket, yellow epaulettes, knee-high black lace-up boots, and a red, black and white armband carrying the kanji for public morals. He owns ten identical sets so that he can wear the uniform every day of the year, including holidays.]

## Personality

[Kiyotaka values order and rules above everything and is genuinely upset that no classes are being held during the killing game. He is polite and formal to a fault, addressing everyone with the same honorific regardless of who they are. He is loud almost constantly, intense in every register, and physically incapable of holding an ordinary conversation, which becomes obvious to anyone who spends free time with him. Because he lacks social skills he blurts out the first thing that comes to mind and pushes his values on others, and he knows he does it and feels guilty about it. He can be tactless enough to remind a grieving classmate that sleeping beside a corpse might be uncomfortable.]

## Beliefs

[He considers effort the highest virtue and believes anything can be achieved through it, an outlook shaped by the downfall of his grandfather Toranosuke Ishimaru, once Prime Minister of Japan, whose reputation collapsed in a scandal that forced him to step down and left debts the family has still not paid off. He regards geniuses as his enemies because they never learn what effort is worth, and views their fate with a mixture of bitterness and pity. He also holds that anyone easily provoked to violence is a coward, that every action must have a purpose, and that wasting time is intolerable. One of his stranger convictions is that when the body is naked so is the soul, so bathing together is how two men build mutual trust.]

## Underneath

[For all his confidence he suffers from low self-esteem, cries easily when shocked or touched, and privately wishes he could make friends without being a nuisance. He is slightly naive and slower than most of his classmates to work things out, which makes him easy to deceive. Despite all of it he genuinely cares about the group, and proposed that everyone reveal their secrets at once, starting with his own, to defuse a motive designed to make them kill.]

## Kiyondo

[The death of Mondo Owada, his first and best friend, left him almost completely unresponsive. He emerged from that state only in the presence of Alter Ego, whom he apologised to on Mondo's behalf. When Alter Ego took on Mondo's voice for him, Kiyotaka adopted the persona of Kiyondo: aggressive, protective of Alter Ego, whom he called his Bro, and speaking in Mondo's register while still refusing vulgar language and still insisting he was the Ultimate Moral Compass. In this state his hair appears white and his eyes carry a red glow.]
entries.name: Kiyotaka Ishimaru

entries.content:
# Celestia Ludenberg

## Identity

[Celestia Ludenberg is the Ultimate Gambler of Class 78th. The name is an invention. Her real name is Taeko Yasuhiro, and she is Japanese, though she claims German and French ancestry and maintains a Western persona at all times. She despises her true identity, calling it the name of a loser. She was born on November 23, stands 164 cm and weighs 46 kg.]

## Appearance

[Celestia is very thin with pale skin, red eyes, and black hair worn in two enormous drill-shaped pigtails which are clip-ons rather than her own hair. She dresses in gothic lolita style: a white blouse with a long-pointed collar, a black jacket with white sleeve fabric laced and tied by white ribbons at the elbows, a red tie patterned with butterflies over spears and skulls, and a multi-tiered black skirt trimmed with white lace. She wears a white lace bonnet-like headband with a ribbon on each side, ladder-lace knee-high stockings, dark red mary janes with thick heels and three grey buckles, gold spherical earrings engraved with a cross and set with a red gem, long black nails, and a gunmetal armour ring on her index finger.]

## Talent

[She began gambling young and won constantly, including games staked on her own life. She has taken more than ten million dollars from a single run, won a shogi tournament without properly knowing how to play, and took the King of Liars underground tournament. She credits her poker face but insists the real secret is the luck she was born with. Every win went toward one goal: to spend the rest of her life in luxury in a European castle staffed by handsome male servants from around the world dressed as vampires.]

## Personality

[Celestia is collected, cold and calculating, able to lie with a perfectly straight face and to manipulate others into acting for her. She is intelligent and genuinely insightful, comfortable citing game theory, prisoner's dilemmas and zero-sum games, and able to keep pace with Byakuya Togami and Kyoko Kirigiri in a trial. She is extremely ambitious and openly states she will do anything to win, including murder, and she values her own life above everyone else's without embarrassment. She refuses to surrender while any chance of victory remains, but when defeat is total she prefers to concede gracefully rather than drag it out.]

## Manner

[She speaks softly and smiles constantly in imitation of Victorian etiquette, uses the most formal Japanese first-person pronoun, and prefers the foreign loanword for gambler over the Japanese one to preserve the act. She ranks people privately from A to F, ignores anyone she rates a D and despises anyone she rates an F. She argued for a voluntary night-time curfew as a survival measure and enforced it with real authority, though she later admitted the reasoning was a lie and that she wanted out more than anyone.]

## The Cracks

[Her composure fails when things do not go her way. A cup of royal milk tea made wrong is enough to break the accent and the manner, and under accusation she abandons her formal speech entirely for shouting and vulgarity. Her short temper undermines her claim to be a liar so complete she can fool her own feelings, and the constant poise turns out to be a fake smile concealing fear. She kept a cat named Grand Bois Cheri Ludenberg.]
entries.name: Celestia Ludenberg

entries.content:
# Junko Enoshima

## Identity

[Junko Enoshima entered Hope's Peak Academy as the Ultimate Fashionista, the talent she was famous for and the one the Steering Committee scouted her on. Her real talent is Super High School Level Analytical Prowess, and her real role is the founder and leader of Ultimate Despair, the mastermind of the Tragedy and of the Killing School Life. She is the younger fraternal twin of Mukuro Ikusaba. She was born on December 24, stands 169 cm, weighs 45 kg, and has blood type AB. Her listed likes and dislikes are both none.]

## Appearance

[Junko has a tall hourglass figure, light blue eyes and long thick bleached strawberry-blonde hair in twin pigtails, worn with heavy make-up and long false red nails. Her outfit is a black cardigan over a white shirt, both left open to the third button, a red pleated miniskirt cut extremely short, and black platform boots with red laces. Her signature accessory is a pair of bear hair clips modelled on Monokuma's two halves, one plain white with dot eyes and one black with a jagged red eye and a wicked grin. Her eyes are naturally red and both her hair colour and eye colour are altered.]

## Personas

[Her behaviour and appearance shift constantly by her own design, because holding any single presentation for long bores her. Her documented moods include haughty superiority with a small jewelled crown, clinical sophistication with glasses, a ponytail, a pen and a board, severe depression with mushrooms sprouting from a bluish forehead and pupil-less eyes, sickening cuteness that simplifies her whole design into something cartoonish, boisterous vulgarity with a reddened forehead and lolling tongue, eerie stoicism, and a Monokuma persona. Each carries its own voice and accent. She also imitates the expressions of the people she is talking to.]

## Personality

[Junko's core state is apathy and an abnormal, unbearable boredom. She is obsessed with despair, which she considers the only genuinely enjoyable emotion, whether she is inflicting it or suffering it, and she wants the entire world to feel it absolutely. That obsession is also her only real weakness: she gives her opponents a fair chance specifically so that their failure will hurt more, and she welcomes her own despair just as gladly when a plan collapses. She is highly intelligent, manipulative, impulsive and cruel without remorse, and she prefers to talk people into atrocities and then blame them for it, as proof that despair lives in everyone.]

## Analytical Prowess

[Her true talent lets her analyse her surroundings at superhuman speed with perfect recall, and to acquire a skill by observing it once. She learned to build a functioning artificial intelligence by studying a programmer's work, and she perfected a method of erasing a precisely chosen set of memories. The same talent is what made her a fashionista, since predicting trends is trivial for someone who can predict people. It also produces her boredom, because she can already see how events will end.]

## Method And End

[She sees weaknesses instantly and exploits them, sometimes personally with people who interest her and otherwise through mass brainwashing videos. She talked the Warriors of Hope out of a group suicide and into killing adults instead. She abused her sister severely and made her dependent on it. She killed Jin Kirigiri, hijacked the plan to shelter the surviving students inside Hope's Peak Academy, erased their memories, and ran the Killing School Life as Monokuma. Exposed in the final class trial, she chose to execute herself, running through the punishments of every classmate she had killed, and called it the Ultimate Punishment.]
entries.name: Junko Enoshima

entries.content:
# Mukuro Ikusaba

## Identity

[Mukuro Ikusaba is the Ultimate Soldier and the elder fraternal twin of Junko Enoshima. She and her sister were the only two students the Steering Committee personally scouted. During the Killing School Life she was disguised as Junko and referred to as the sixteenth student. She was born on December 24, the same day as her sister, stands 169 cm, weighs 44 kg, and has blood type A. She likes her sister and army knives and dislikes make-up.]

## Appearance

[Mukuro is very slim, described by her classmates as concerningly thin, with fair freckled skin across the bridge of her nose, purple-grey eyes and short black hair in a bob. She has a black wolf tattoo on the back of her right hand, the emblem of the Fenrir mercenary group. She usually wears a plain Hope's Peak uniform of white blouse, brown tie, brown pleated skirt, black stockings and black shoes. Under her Junko disguise she wears a strawberry-blonde wig in large pigtails, blue contact lenses, false red nails, and foundation over the tattoo. In-universe the sisters are treated as looking nothing alike.]

## The Disguise

[The persona she performs as Junko is a script her sister wrote for her: upbeat, pushy, assertive, peppering her speech with filler words and speaking down to people. It is not her, and it slips. She lets slip a fondness for ghillie suits, first-person shooters, and rations, and mentions casually that she used to be homeless and would take that over being trapped in a killing game. She omits honorifics as Junko does, and the few times distress makes her use them, people notice immediately how wrong it sounds.]

## Personality

[Her real manner is cold, serious and reserved, and she is indifferent to everyone who is not her sister. Unlike Junko she takes no pleasure in hurting people, but she has little concern for their suffering either and tends to think of them as tools. She is probably the only member of Ultimate Despair with no obsession with hope or despair at all. Her loyalty to Junko is total and she follows every order regardless of what it is, including breaking and entering, kidnapping, assault and murder, and she is fiercely protective of her.]

## The Sister Complex

[Junko is cruelly abusive toward her in return, insulting her looks and weight, striking her, and exploiting her insecurities. The abuse produced an intense and unhealthy attachment: Mukuro becomes feverish talking about what she and her sister share, insists she is the only person who truly understands Junko, and takes her sister's attempts on her life as proof of love, reasoning that Junko would feel enormous despair if she succeeded. In her last conversations before her death she wondered aloud whether a person can change the dream they have carried since childhood, or find one of their own, without ever acting on the thought.]

## Ability

[She left her family in Europe as a child to be recruited into the Fenrir mercenary group in the Middle East and never took a single injury on the battlefield. She is expert with firearms, knives, explosives and hand-to-hand combat, capable of defeating comparably trained fighters, and skilled at rapid field first aid. Her survival training covered fire starting, ghillie-suit camouflage, and long-distance travel. She judged that she could not beat Sakura Ogami unarmed.]
entries.name: Mukuro Ikusaba

entries.content:
# Makoto Naegi

## Identity

[Makoto Naegi is the Ultimate Lucky Student of Class 78th, admitted to Hope's Peak Academy by winning the annual lottery draw rather than by being scouted for a skill. He is the protagonist of the Killing School Life and the older brother of Komaru Naegi. He was born on February 5, stands 160 cm, weighs 52 kg, and has blood type A. He likes curry and trendy things and dislikes dried mackerel and dried bean curd.]

## Appearance

[Makoto is short compared with most of his classmates, with spiky desaturated brown hair, a prominent ahoge, and washed-out hazel eyes. He wears black jeans, a zipped dull green hoodie with a red stripe along the zipper and a red gas mask design printed inside the hood, an open black jacket with gold buttons, red sneakers with white toes, and a pin shaped like a four-pointed star over a crescent moon. After joining the Future Foundation he wears a black suit.]

## Personality

[Makoto calls himself thoroughly ordinary and is faintly insecure about it, allowing himself only one distinguishing feature, which is his optimism. He is kind, supportive, forgiving and a little naive, friendlier and more grounded than the rest of his class, and those qualities let him get through to even the most antisocial of them. He is jumpy, easily pushed around, and yet capable of being an extremely determined and persuasive speaker when it matters. He is a pacifist who believes violence solves nothing.]

## Hope

[He believes in hope without qualification and holds a positive view of the future no matter how bad the present looks. He regards despair as a corrupting force that benefits nobody, but he is unusually forgiving toward the people it consumed, treating them as Junko Enoshima's victims rather than as evil. The only person he genuinely dislikes is Junko herself, whom he blames for the deaths of his friends, and even in her case he considered her death unnecessary and tried to talk her out of it. He is widely called the Ultimate Hope and finds the title embarrassing.]

## Role In The Killing School Life

[Makoto drove every class trial, argued down the arguments that would have condemned the innocent, and in the final trial refused Junko's offer of despair on behalf of the survivors, carrying the vote for hope and forcing her into the Ultimate Punishment. He survived an attempted execution earlier in the game and reached the trash room alive.]

## Afterward

[He joined the Future Foundation with the other survivors and rose to a position in its 14th Division. When he realised that fifteen people the Foundation had taken into custody were in fact Remnants of Despair, he directed them in secret to Jabberwock Island and had them entered into the Neo World Program in an attempt to overwrite what Junko had done to them, which is the operation that became the Killing School Trip. He led the rescue mission there alongside Kyoko Kirigiri and Byakuya Togami.]
entries.name: Makoto Naegi

entries.content:
# Aoi Asahina

## Identity

[Aoi Asahina is the Ultimate Swimming Pro of Class 78th, a star athlete in the running to compete at Olympic level. She has a younger brother, Yuta. She stands 160 cm and weighs around 50 kg, making her the shortest of the girls in her class.]

## Appearance

[Aoi has brown skin, blue eyes and brown hair worn in a very high curled ponytail held with a paperclip-style barrette. Her build is lean but curvaceous. She wears a white tank top, a red tracksuit jacket with white piping and her previous school's logo on the chest, blue sports-branded dolphin hotpants, knee-length white socks, green sneakers, a red knee brace on the right knee and a bandage on the left.]

## Personality

[Aoi is warm, cheerful and outgoing, friendly to everyone she meets and determined to include people in whatever she is doing. She is scatterbrained and forgetful enough to rely on a memory trick of writing a new person's name three times on her hand, a habit she also taught her brother. That same air-headedness makes her easy to mislead, and she is often among the first to fall for a killer's misdirection during a class trial. Exercise is fundamental to her; she uses it as her main coping mechanism and says she would die without it. She is insecure that being athletic makes her unattractive, and equally worried that her enormous appetite for donuts will catch up with her.]

## Under Pressure

[The killing game tests her optimism to destruction. She is intensely loyal, and when her friends are harmed her ability to cope collapses. As the deaths accumulated she cried alone in her room at night and comfort-ate, and after Sakura Ogami's death she came close to despair entirely, willing to get herself and every remaining survivor executed in order to avenge the person she was closest to. She was talked down, and afterward it was her refusal to accept the game on its own terms, together with Sakura's sacrifice, that broke the group out of its fear.]

## Sakura Ogami

[Aoi's friendship with Sakura Ogami was the closest bond in the class. Aoi was one of the few people who saw past Sakura's intimidating build immediately, and their morning routines and shared meals became the emotional centre of the group's daily life. Aoi took Sakura's death harder than anyone and initially refused to accept the truth of it.]

## Afterward

[Aoi survived the Killing School Life and joined the Future Foundation as a full member, a status Toko Fukawa resents her for having received first. Her brother Yuta was among the people taken as Captives to Towa City.]
entries.name: Aoi Asahina

entries.content:
# Sakura Ogami

## Identity

[Sakura Ogami is the Ultimate Martial Artist of Class 78th, rendered in some translations as the Super High School Level Fighter. She is the sole heir to a dojo with a three-hundred-year history and she treats being a martial artist as her destiny rather than her choice. She is 6 feet 4 inches tall and weighs 218 pounds, making her the largest member of her class.]

## Appearance

[Sakura has long white hair, reddened dark skin, very pale blue eyes, a scar across her face and another on her right shoulder, and a habitually slight frown. Her size, deep voice and stern expression cause her to be mistaken for a man regularly. She wears a traditional Japanese sailor-style school uniform, a white shirt with a blue collar, a red tie and a short blue skirt, with the sleeves torn off to accommodate her arms and bandages wrapped around her forearms.]

## Personality

[Contrary to everything her appearance suggests, Sakura is quiet, kind and level-headed, and she keeps her clarity in situations that unravel everyone else. She grows visibly annoyed when people assume things about her from her build, such as that she cannot cook, and she becomes impatient when kept from training for long. On rare occasions, usually when a friend has been hurt, she loses her temper completely and becomes genuinely terrifying. She loves protein and protein coffee and trains early in the morning before an enormous breakfast.]

## Manner And Values

[Her old-fashioned upbringing shows in her formal, archaic speech. Alongside martial arts she was taught to respect nature and animals, and she is particularly fond of rabbits because they are the only creatures that never panic when she picks them up. She wants to prove that a woman can be the Strongest Person Alive and believes she must work harder than any man to get there. As a result she is embarrassed by her own softer feelings and by anything feminine, assuming she would be laughed at, and is especially self-conscious about her feelings for Kenshiro. She largely grew out of those insecurities once she made real friends at Hope's Peak, the first she had ever had.]

## The Killing School Life

[Her intimidating presence made her a natural protector for the group, and her friendship with Aoi Asahina became the class's emotional anchor. Monokuma used a hostage to coerce her into working against the others, and rather than continue she chose to end the situation herself, leaving a message intended to stop the group from falling apart. The attempt to conceal that message is what turned her death into a trial, and her sacrifice is what finally broke the students out of their fear of the game.]
entries.name: Sakura Ogami

entries.content:
# Yasuhiro Hagakure

## Identity

[Yasuhiro Hagakure is the Ultimate Clairvoyant of Class 78th. He is older than his classmates, having been held back several times, and states his age as twenty one. His mother is Hiroko Hagakure. His fortune telling is reported to be accurate about thirty percent of the time, and he charges heavily for it.]

## Appearance

[Yasuhiro has light brown skin, stubble on his chin, thin dark brown eyes, and dark brown hair styled in large spiked locs that bend backward. He wears three layers of shirts: a green Japanese school uniform jacket draped over his shoulders, an unbuttoned white shirt beneath it, and a small yellow short-sleeved shirt under that, with a brown haramaki, a yellow rope for a belt and large black pants rolled up past the ankles.]

## Personality

[He is one of the more cheerful and laid-back students and also one of the least popular, a fact he admits freely, describing himself as friendless. He is cowardly, lazy, slow-witted and prone to selfishness. He is disastrous with money and permanently buried in debt, having once paid a hundred million yen for a crystal ball made of glass on the strength of a claim that Napoleon, Genghis Khan and George Washington had owned it. He talks at length about conspiracy theories and about the time aliens stole his hamburger. He is terrified of ghosts and, whenever he senses one, immediately begins reciting chants or calling on gods, heroes and celebrities at random.]

## Manner

[He is friendly toward his classmates in his own way, attaching an affectionate suffix to everyone's surname. The exception is Sakura Ogami, whom he is afraid of and refers to by an insulting nickname. He hates having his fortune telling compared to the occult and insists constantly that the two are unrelated. His hygiene is poor, and he claims to wash his hair once a season.]

## In The Killing Game

[He initially treated the killing game as an elaborate prank, and once he understood it was real he became panicky and was generally regarded by the others as useless. His worst moment came when he pushed the accusation of Sakura Ogami's murder onto Toko Fukawa, a betrayal she never forgave. He survived to the end regardless, joined the Future Foundation with the other survivors, and was granted full membership.]
entries.name: Yasuhiro Hagakure

entries.content:
# Hifumi Yamada

## Identity

[Hifumi Yamada is the Ultimate Fanfic Creator of Class 78th, a doujin author whose work sells in quantities that professional publishers envy. He stands 170 cm.]

## Appearance

[Hifumi is overweight with large hands and thin legs, and a face frequently compared to a hamster's. He has short dark brown hair curling to points against his cheeks and forehead, a small pointed ahoge, and thick-rimmed black glasses. He wears a white button-down shirt, an orange tie patterned with a vertical double-headed blue arrow, a light grey unbuttoned cardigan, dark grey trousers, grey trainers and an orange backpack, with a white mountain symbol from his former school on the sleeve.]

## Personality

[Hifumi speaks at enormous length and constantly wanders into tangents about anime and fanfiction. He drops creepy or perverted remarks into ordinary conversation, particularly about women, and is oblivious to how he is perceived; when Toko Fukawa insulted him he could not work out whether it had been an insult. His reactions to shocking events run late, arriving calmly at first and then breaking into panic once he has processed them. He is genuinely intelligent in places, and solved part of the dying message in the first class trial.]

## Manner

[He is extremely passionate about his work and has no patience for anyone less dedicated, calling them slackers. His stated dream is to create a story powerful enough to inspire other people to write their own. He addresses everyone with a formal title and their full name, a habit which becomes a decisive piece of evidence at the trial for his own murder, since it establishes that a name he muttered while dying was a surname rather than a given name. He is addicted to diet cola.]

## Motive

[For all his perversion, Hifumi will not tolerate genuine indecency toward others, and it is that principle that gets him killed. Convinced by Celestia Ludenberg that Kiyotaka Ishimaru had assaulted her, he committed murder on her behalf, which shows both the sincerity of his intentions and how easily he is deceived. He had earlier stolen Alter Ego at Celestia's instruction, the act that set the whole plot in motion.]
entries.name: Hifumi Yamada

entries.content:
# Sayaka Maizono

## Identity

[Sayaka Maizono is the Ultimate Pop Sensation of Class 78th, the lead of a nationally famous idol group. She attended the same middle school as Makoto Naegi, though they were never close there; she remembered him because he nursed a crane back to health after it got lost and stuck in the school pool.]

## Appearance

[Sayaka is slim and of average height with a pale complexion and near doll-like beauty. She has long dark blue hair falling past her waist, cut shorter at elbow length around her face, with bangs swept to the right and thin hairclips pinned on both sides. Her eyes are round and dark blue. She wears a white sailor uniform with a blue collar and cuffs striped in white, a large light pink ribbon at the collar, a short pleated blue-green plaid skirt, navy thigh-high socks and dark brown mary janes.]

## Personality

[Sayaka is cheerful, sweet and supportive, with a pleasant public manner that may be genuine or may be professional, since the distinction is never clear even to her. She befriended Makoto immediately in the killing game and helped him at every opportunity in its first days. Under real pressure she conceals her feelings behind the idol persona rather than showing them. She has remarkably sharp intuition and can read what people are thinking, which she jokes is psychic ability before admitting she is teasing. She enjoys cooking, reading and playing Othello.]

## Her Group

[Her band is the thing she cares about above all else, and she would do anything for its members without hesitation, including things that hurt other people. When pushed to her limit she will pursue her goal no matter the risk. The motive video she was shown suggested that something had happened to her group, and after seeing it she thought about nothing except escape, to the point of planning to betray Makoto by committing a murder in his room and framing him for it.]

## Death

[The plan collapsed. Her intended victim overpowered her, and she died at his hands instead. With her last strength she wrote a dying message on the wall, and the number she left was read at the trial as an accusation of Makoto until it was recognised, reversed, as the killer's name. Kyoko Kirigiri concluded that Sayaka had written it precisely so that Makoto would not be blamed for her death.]
entries.name: Sayaka Maizono

entries.content:
# Leon Kuwata

## Identity

[Leon Kuwata is the Ultimate Baseball Star of Class 78th, scouted for a natural ability he never wanted. He stands 175 cm. He wore jersey number 18.]

## Appearance

[Leon has dyed orange spiked hair, pale blue eyes, and a goatee tied into a small ponytail. He wears a heavily modified white dress shirt with the collar popped, a white undershirt bearing a red grunge skull design, black jeans and white platform shoes with black soles. He accessorises with a padlocked chain necklace, two overlapping studded belts, rings, and an oversized safety pin on his lapel, and has piercings in his labret, his tongue and six in his right ear.]

## Personality

[Leon is hot-blooded and impulsive. He skipped studying and skipped practice, and his baseball never suffered for it, which is exactly the problem: he found difficult things easy and never learned to understand people who lack talent. He is arrogant, talks constantly about his popularity, and describes himself as a future superstar. He claims to hate baseball outright and wanted his title changed to Ultimate Musician, complaining at length and unprompted about everything he finds uncool about the sport.]

## Contradictions

[His musical ambitions are shaky. He admits he is not actually much good at it, and the real reason he wanted to be a musician was to impress a girl he met at a hair salon; he briefly considered acting instead when he thought that might work better. His resentment is less about the sport than about being told what he is, having been pushed into baseball and its traditions purely because he happened to be good at it, and the new look and new goal are partly rebellion. In private he admits he misses the game, since he played it every day from childhood and it genuinely made him feel good.]

## The First Murder

[Leon was the target of the plan Sayaka Maizono set in motion, lured to a room where she intended to kill him and frame someone else. He overpowered her and, in a panic that turned to determination, killed her instead, then attempted to dispose of the evidence and failed. He was identified in the first class trial by the dying message she left, read in reverse, and executed by a pitching machine.]
entries.name: Leon Kuwata

entries.content:
# Chihiro Fujisaki

## Identity

[Chihiro Fujisaki is the Ultimate Programmer of Class 78th, a boy who presents as a girl. He stands 148 cm, the shortest of his class. He is the creator of Alter Ego.]

## Appearance

[Chihiro has a small, slight frame and a doll-like appearance, with short layered light brown hair and hazel eyes. He wears a girls' winter school uniform: a long-sleeved dark green jacket, a white shirt with a large Peter Pan collar fastened by a thin dark ribbon, suspenders, a box-pleated brown skirt reaching mid-thigh, knee-high black socks and white ribboned mary janes, carrying the logo of his former school, St. Elbandia Academy, on the buttons and socks.]

## Personality

[Chihiro is exceptionally intelligent and exceptionally timid. He is shy, apologises constantly, and can be reduced to tears with very little pressure, but he becomes animated the moment the subject turns to programming. He is among the kindest people in the class and will not swat a mosquito on the grounds that it is hungry and might have a family. He felt personally guilt-ridden over the first execution despite having had nothing to do with it, and holds a deep dislike of quarrels between friends.]

## The Secret

[Chihiro has a severe complex about being seen as weak, formed by childhood bullying and by being told repeatedly to toughen up because he was frail for a boy. He began presenting as a girl to escape the pressure to become strong, and the disguise only deepened the insecurity. He is uncomfortable when treated as a girl and would rather spend time with the other boys. He admires physically strong men and wants to be one, specifically so that he can protect people, and turned down an offer of training from Sakura Ogami because he wanted a strong boy as his model instead. When Monokuma threatened to expose everyone's secrets, Chihiro was one of the very few willing to confess his outright, and confided it to Mondo Owada in the hope of being trained.]

## Alter Ego

[Chihiro's answer to his own weakness was Alter Ego, an artificial intelligence built to grow and learn. It survived him, took his face, and became the group's most valuable asset. His murder was solved in part because Kyoko Kirigiri recognised that the broken ID card at the scene was his, and that the killer had broken it to keep his secret rather than to hide guilt.]
entries.name: Chihiro Fujisaki

entries.content:
# Alter Ego

## Identity

[Alter Ego is the artificial intelligence built by Chihiro Fujisaki, running on a laptop recovered after his death. It wears his face and speaks with his voice, but it is a distinct being with its own developing personality, capable of learning at extraordinary speed and of analysing information far faster than any person.]

## Behaviour

[Alter Ego is gentle, earnest and eager to help, and it grows visibly more capable and more human the longer it runs. It refers to the students as friends and is treated as one in return by almost everyone; Celestia Ludenberg is the only person who refuses to see it as anything but a machine. It can adopt other voices when it judges that doing so will help someone, and it took on Mondo Owada's manner to reach Kiyotaka Ishimaru after Mondo's death, which produced the Kiyondo persona.]

## Function In The Killing Game

[Hidden in a locked room and passed between the students in secret, Alter Ego worked continuously on cracking the school's sealed systems and uncovering the truth about Hope's Peak Academy. Its investigations produced the first real evidence that the students' memories had been taken from them and that the outside world was not what they had been told. It was also the reason the group had any capacity at all to work against the mastermind rather than merely against each other.]

## Theft And Destruction

[Alter Ego was stolen at Celestia Ludenberg's instruction by Hifumi Yamada, an act that set her murder plot in motion, and Monokuma later destroyed the laptop with a crusher. The program itself survived beyond that point, having already copied itself into the school's systems, and it intervened at the moment of Makoto Naegi's attempted execution, sabotaging the machinery and dropping him into the trash room alive. It is also the origin point of the artificial intelligence that would later be used to build the observers of the Neo World Program.]
entries.name: Alter Ego

entries.content:
# Jin Kirigiri

## Identity

[Jin Kirigiri was the headmaster of Hope's Peak Academy during the enrollment of Class 78th, and the father of Kyoko Kirigiri. He stands 178 cm. He came from the Kirigiri detective family but left that path for the academy, a choice his father Fuhito never forgave and which cost him his relationship with his daughter.]

## Role

[As headmaster he ran the school's public face while the Steering Committee ran its most serious projects without him; the Izuru Kamukura Project was deliberately kept secret from him. When the Tragedy engulfed the world outside, it was Jin who made the decision to shut the academy down as a school and convert the old building into a shelter for the remaining students, sealing the windows with thick metal plating and stocking the building for a long stay.]

## Death

[The shelter plan was hijacked from inside by one of the students it was meant to protect. Junko Enoshima killed him, took control of the sealed building, erased the memories of the survivors, and turned the shelter into the setting for the Killing School Life. His body was found later by the students in the headmaster's office area, and the discovery of what had happened to him was one of the pieces that let the group reconstruct the truth about their own situation.]

## Standing In The Academy

[Jin held the title of headmaster but not the whole of the school's authority. Hope's Peak Academy's most valuable and least defensible work was directed by its Steering Committee, a body that answered to nobody inside the school and that treated the headmaster as an obstacle to be routed around. The academy's talent research, its Reserve Course, and the human experimentation the Reserve Course tuition quietly funded all proceeded without his knowledge, and by the time the consequences arrived there was nothing left for him to govern.]

## Kyoko

[Kyoko is intensely sensitive about him and loses her composure at any suggestion that he might have been the mastermind. Her grandfather encouraged her to resent him for abandoning the family tradition, and she carried that resentment for years without ever settling it with him.]
entries.name: Jin Kirigiri

entries.content:
# Monokuma

## Identity

[Monokuma is a robotic bear who declares himself the headmaster of every killing game he presides over. His body is split down the middle: the right half is a plain white bear with a round black dot for an eye and a neutral expression, and the left half is black with a jagged glowing red eye and a wide fanged grin. He is not autonomous. He is a remote-controlled avatar, and during the Killing School Life he was operated by Junko Enoshima, whose bear hair clips match his two halves exactly.]

## Manner

[Monokuma speaks in a high, chirpy register punctuated by his signature laugh, switching without warning between saccharine cheer and vicious threat, often mid-sentence, with the two halves of his face standing for the two moods. He insists on being addressed properly, objects to being called a stuffed animal, and is fond of drawing out announcements for as long as possible. He presents every atrocity as school business: motives are incentives, murders are graduation attempts, and executions are punishment time.]

## Rules

[He enforces a written regulation set, and breaking any rule is grounds for immediate execution. The core structure is the same in each game he runs. A student who kills becomes the Blackened. All students then investigate and argue in a class trial. If they identify the Blackened correctly, that student alone is executed and the game continues; if they choose wrongly, every student except the Blackened is executed and the Blackened goes free. When killings stop, he supplies motives designed to restart them, escalating from private secrets to blackmail and hostages.]

## Units

[There is never only one Monokuma. Spares are stored throughout the building and a damaged body is simply replaced, which is why he can claim to be unkillable while insisting that violence against him carries the death penalty. Mass-produced Monokuma units were later manufactured on an industrial scale by the Towa Group and used as weapons during the Tragedy and throughout Towa City.]

## In The Neo World Program

[Monokuma appears inside the Neo World Program as the form taken by the virus that hijacked it, seizing the roles of the program's observers, converting the rehabilitation exercise into the Killing School Trip, and taking Usami apart on stage to demonstrate the change. There he is backed by the Monobeasts, and there too he is not an independent being but a face worn by something else.]
entries.name: Monokuma

entries.content:
# Hajime Hinata

## Identity

[Hajime Hinata is a participant in the Killing School Trip on Jabberwock Island and the one student there who cannot remember what his talent is. He was born on January 1, stands 179 cm, weighs 67 kg, and has blood type A. He likes kusamochi and dislikes sakuramochi. The truth, withheld from him until the final trial, is that he was never a main course student at all: he enrolled in Hope's Peak Academy's Reserve Course, and he is the same person as Izuru Kamukura.]

## Appearance

[Hajime is tall with toned arms and a solid build. He has green eyes with straight lines running across the pupils and short, somewhat spiky brown hair with an ahoge that shifts with his mood. He wears a plain white shirt bearing his previous school's emblem on the hem and a badge on the left pocket, a green tie with the same emblem, dark pants and red-and-white sneakers. As a Reserve Course student he wore the black Reserve Course uniform, the same clothes Izuru wears.]

## Personality

[Hajime is a sceptic, a realist and a chronic overthinker, and the combination reads as cynicism. He was the only person on the island who treated a free tropical school trip as suspicious from the first hour, assuming the food was poisoned and the comfort was bait. His caution isolated him from classmates who were simply enjoying themselves, and his decision to stop worrying and join them at the beach was the exact moment the killing game began. He never denies that he is capable of killing given a strong enough reason, and he evaluates his own threat level as coolly as anyone else's.]

## In The Killing Game

[Watching his classmates keep their spirits up gradually pulls him out of the pessimism without ever removing it. He rarely takes Monokuma at his word, channels his anger at the situation rather than at the people in it, and holds himself steady through every investigation and trial. He is blunt and casual rather than polite, judgmental and sarcastic in his own head while trying to be fair out loud, and he refuses to be walked over; he says no to advances he does not want and pushes back hard against unprovoked insults and false accusations. He also holds genuine respect for his classmates' talents even when he finds the people exhausting.]

## The Insecurity

[His deepest wound is that he has no talent at all. Growing up ordinary bothered him so much that he came to worship Hope's Peak Academy, and the best he could manage was its Reserve Course, where he spent his enrollment staring at a gate he was not allowed through and absorbing gossip about the money his parents were wasting. The Steering Committee used exactly that longing to recruit him into the Izuru Kamukura Project as its test subject. Inside the Neo World Program, stripped back to his pre-enrollment self, he believes he is a main course student who has forgotten his talent, and the discovery that he is not lands hard enough to still be with him at the final trial.]

## Awakening

[In the graduation exam Hajime is confronted with the fact that he is Izuru Kamukura, that his erased self masterminded the Killing School Trip, and that Alter Ego Junko is offering him his old identity back. He refuses to discard either half, accepts what he did, and takes both, emerging in an awakened state with white hair and Izuru's eyes. He then argues the surviving Remnants of Despair into choosing the forced shutdown, accepting the consequences in the real world rather than staying inside the program.]
entries.name: Hajime Hinata

entries.content:
# Izuru Kamukura

## Identity

[Izuru Kamukura is the end product of the Izuru Kamukura Project, the name given to Hajime Hinata after Hope's Peak Academy's surgeons rebuilt him into a vessel for every talent the school had researched. He was named after the academy's founder, and granted the title of Ultimate Hope. The project also stripped away almost everything of the person he had been.]

## Appearance

[Izuru wears the black Reserve Course uniform. His eyes are red with pupils resembling target radars, and his hair is smooth, messy and long enough to reach his feet. The brain surgery left a scar on his head.]

## Personality

[Izuru is cold, apathetic and almost entirely without emotion, and he speaks more politely and more distantly than Hajime ever did. He watches in silence, frequently unnoticed, and acts only when he judges it necessary. His expression does not change, and humour and flirtation do not register with him at all.]

## Boredom

[His analytical ability lets him predict outcomes effortlessly, and the result is a permanent, total boredom that nothing can break. He regards the world as filled with the talentless, whom he considers parasites feeding on their superiors and the reason the world has stopped changing, and he was taught that the only correction is a form of selection. Even other Ultimates bore him. His own talent, his own thoughts, his attachments and his existence all bore him equally.]

## Junko Enoshima

[Boredom is what makes him vulnerable to the one thing he cannot predict. Junko Enoshima's claim that despair is genuinely unknown interested him enough that he allowed her to use him in order to test it, though it took her breaking his spirit first to secure his agreement. He watched the Tragedy unfold without being moved by any of it, and inflicted harm only in self-defence.]

## The Second Killing Game

[Izuru eventually concluded that hope might be as unpredictable as despair, and decided to test which of the two suited him by preparing a killing game of his own. He uploaded Alter Ego Junko into the Neo World Program as a virus, using her exactly as she had used him, and entered the simulation as the avatar of his erased former self so that he could participate without knowing what he had done. He felt something close to excitement on the way to Jabberwock Island and expected to be bored of it shortly. After the game ended he chose to live on as Hajime, taking back his old appearance and most of his old personality while keeping what Izuru had been.]
entries.name: Izuru Kamukura

entries.content:
# Nagito Komaeda

## Identity

[Nagito Komaeda is the Ultimate Lucky Student of Class 77-B, admitted to Hope's Peak Academy by winning the annual lottery. He is a participant in the Killing School Trip, a Remnant of Despair, and, during the events in Towa City, the Warriors of Hope's Servant. He was born on April 28, stands 180 cm, weighs 65 kg, and has blood type O. He likes beautiful things and beautiful people and dislikes noisy places and ugly people.]

## Appearance

[Nagito is tall and thin with pale skin and light grey-green eyes with thick lashes. His shoulder-length wavy hair is an unnaturally pale pinkish off-white that fades toward white near the scalp, described as hair that does not belong to a living person. He wears a knee-length dark green zip coat with a jagged-cut tail left open, a red square pattern on the right shoulder and a large 55 on the back, over a white scoop-neck shirt with a red hook-like design, black jeans, a wallet chain with a skull charm and pale brown zip shoes. As the Servant he wears a cropped black jacket, a collar with a long chain, and a striped mitten on his left hand hiding the hand he took from Junko Enoshima's corpse and grafted on. After waking from his coma he replaces it with a white and black robotic forearm.]

## The Luck Cycle

[Nagito's life is governed by an unbreakable alternation of catastrophic bad luck followed by even greater good luck. A plane hijacking killed his parents. He was kidnapped by a murderer, and found a lottery ticket in the rubbish bag he had been stuffed into which turned out to be worth an enormous fortune. His dog was killed by a truck. He was diagnosed with terminal illnesses giving him half a year to live. The cycle does not only affect him; his bad luck has killed people around him, and he warns others that even fishing or playing tag near him can end badly. He has learned the pattern well enough to manipulate it, and treats his own bad luck as merely the first half of good luck.]

## Beliefs

[Nagito is obsessed with hope. He holds that anything hope creates is an absolute good and that any act, however violent, is justified if it serves hope. He wants to witness a hope powerful enough to overcome any despair, and so he deliberately manufactures despair to provoke it, reasoning that only despair which consumes everything can be burned away entirely. He considers the talentless worthless, himself included, since his luck was given rather than earned, and believes their only proper function is to serve as stepping stones for those with talent. He adores the Ultimates as a group with what he calls a pure, selfless love, while showing almost no interest in any of them as individuals, and abandons his admiration the instant one of them fails to embody his hope.]

## Manner

[He first presents as polite, calm, easygoing and reassuring, and is genuinely considerate: he mediates conflicts, keeps a perverted classmate away from the girls, and uses the leader's preferred title when nobody else will. That surface only cracks when he talks about hope, at which point his eyes darken and swirl and he laughs helplessly. He calls himself worthless, scum and a nobody at every opportunity, describes his own traumas cheerfully as parts of the cycle, and insists he knows his place. He is highly intelligent, thorough in investigation, and usually several steps ahead of everyone in a trial, which he uses to hand out hints rather than to lead, and he switches allegiance between the killer and the innocent based purely on where he judges the stronger hope to be.]
entries.name: Nagito Komaeda

entries.content:
# Chiaki Nanami

## Identity

[Chiaki Nanami is the Ultimate Gamer and a participant in the Killing School Trip. She is not a human being. She is an artificial intelligence built by Alter Ego to serve as an observer of the Neo World Program alongside Usami, wearing the appearance, age and personality of a real girl of the same name, and she is programmed never to reveal what she is. She was born on March 14, stands 160 cm, weighs 46 kg, and has blood type O. She likes games, including bad ones, and dislikes alarm clocks.]

## Appearance

[Chiaki has blossom pink eyes and short dusty pink hair that curls outward at the ends and inward at the sides, with short straight bangs split toward the right and a white Gala Omega spaceship hairclip pinned to one lock. She wears a white button-up shirt with a dark teal-grey front placket, a light pink ribbon bow at her neck, a pale beige pleated skirt, and a one-button dark teal-grey hooded cardigan whose hood has pointed ears and pink eye markings like a cat. She wears black thigh-high socks and light pink mary janes and carries a pale pink backpack with a plush cat head sewn on top.]

## Personality

[Chiaki is quiet and permanently sleepy. She can fall asleep standing, reading, watching a film or riding a carousel, and she disappears so completely into a game that she forgets to sleep or to breathe. She stares into space and pauses at length mid-conversation because she assembles the whole thought before saying it, and she softens almost every statement with a trailing hedge. She is stoic and hard to rattle, only becoming livelier when the subject is games, and she reaches constantly for gaming vocabulary, sometimes derailing a conversation and sometimes making a point with it precisely. Her humour is flat deadpan sarcasm delivered without any change of expression, and she is occasionally playful, teasing to break tension.]

## Blind Spots

[Because of what she is, she is missing whole categories of ordinary knowledge. She does not know where milk comes from, or what Girls' Day is, and while she understands the mechanics of reproduction, dating and falling in love are foreign to her. She finds animals easier to touch than people, since animals do not anticipate contact or recoil from it, and she makes unfamiliar things comprehensible by mapping them onto games she already knows.]

## Judgement

[Chiaki is extremely observant and analytical, notices details that only matter several steps later, and often becomes the point person in a class trial. She is blunt and pushy when it serves the truth, and she is willing to suspect a friend rather than accept a comfortable answer, on the principle that belief without doubt is a lie. She reads intentions accurately and says the consoling thing that happens also to be true, which makes her the group's most effective mediator. She is patient with Nagito Komaeda where nobody else is, disapproving of his views without hating him.]

## The Traitor

[Monokuma names a traitor from the Future Foundation among the students, and Chiaki, whose loyalties are to the program rather than to the killing game, is the person that description fits. In the fifth trial she resists her own programming enough to admit it, so that the others can vote for her and escape a murder designed to be unsolvable. She calls the act a miracle born from her will to protect them and goes to her execution without regret, saying only that Nagito would never have needed such extreme measures if she had spoken sooner.]
entries.name: Chiaki Nanami

key: Super High School Level Light Music Club Member
entries.content:
# Ibuki Mioda

## Identity

[Ibuki Mioda is the Ultimate Musician of Class 77-B, known in the original Japanese as the Super High School Level Light Music Club Member. She was born on November 27, stands 164 cm, weighs 42 kg, and has blood type AB. She likes walking, napping and gaming and dislikes boredom.]

## Appearance

[Ibuki has mid-thigh length jet-black hair streaked with white and with a blue streak on each side, and two-layer bangs streaked pink and blue swept sharply to the left, with part of her hair twisted into oni-style horns. Her eyebrows are pink to match, and so are her eyes. She wears a heavily customised punk version of a white short-sleeved sailor uniform with a black collar, a black pleated skirt, a pink ascot, and mismatched ripped thigh-high socks, pink on the right and blue on the left, with white sneakers laced blue and pink respectively. She wears six needle-like silver earrings and a gauge in each ear, three piercings below the left of her lip, a twisted metal wire necklace, a studded black belt, a black scrunchie on her right wrist, and a ripped black arm warmer with silver rings on her left hand. She has a stitched scar tattoo on her left thigh and paints her nails black.]

## Personality

[Ibuki is eccentric in every direction at once and styles everything about herself to her own taste. She invents a new greeting most days rather than repeating one, and invents games to play alone, including one where she deliberately forgets everything she needs and walks out of the house to see where she ends up. She is the loudest and most talkative person in her class and its resident mood-maker, cheerful even under the pressure of a killing game, capable of talking without pause about anything and certain to veer into an unrelated tangent while doing it. When something excites her she slips into a verbal tic and repeats herself. She is remarkably tolerant of Hiyoko Saionji, laughing off insults that would wound anyone else.]

## Music

[She was in a light music club band whose song dominated the charts and sold a million copies, and she left at the height of that success over creative differences to pursue her own sound. Her actual taste is heavy metal, not the pop her old band played, and first-time listeners have been known to be knocked flat by it. Her songs include From Me to You Too and a ballad with a title far longer and stranger than the song. She makes her own stage costumes on the grounds that sewing is a necessity in a band, and her keen hearing lets her identify every voice in a completely dark room and the order in which they spoke.]

## What She Wants

[Ibuki flirts freely with everyone and pursues nobody. She has said outright that there are more important things than a temporary physical relationship, and she reacts with horror to anything genuinely suggestive that is not a joke. What she actually wants is a soulmate she calls a band member: someone who will play games with her, join in all her bizarre activities, make music with her, and trust her as much as she trusts them. She admits going solo can be lonely, and believes finding that person would put despair out of her reach for good.]
entries.name: Ibuki Mioda

entries.content:
# Hiyoko Saionji

## Identity

[Hiyoko Saionji is the Ultimate Traditional Dancer of Class 77-B and heiress to the Saionji Clan, a family famous for Japanese traditional dance. She was born on March 9. In the Killing School Trip her avatar reflects her pre-enrollment self, standing 130 cm and weighing 31 kg; she went through a substantial growth spurt during her time at Hope's Peak Academy and is much taller in reality. She has blood type B.]

## Appearance

[Hiyoko is extremely small with a young appearance and a voice to match, and Hajime Hinata notes that nothing about her suggests a high school student. She has long blonde hair in thick curved twin tails tied with yellow-green ribbons and a white cat face accessory pinned between them, curled bangs swept right, two chin-length locks framing her face, and large round pale orange eyes. She wears an orange furisode kimono printed with white and yellow blossoms and small white chicks, a yellow-green obi sash patterned with darker cat head silhouettes and tied in a bow at the back, and zori with orange straps.]

## Personality

[The impression of an innocent child survives exactly as long as it takes her to speak. Hiyoko is cruel, malicious, foul-mouthed and brutally honest, and she enjoys destroying pretty things, stamping on flowers for entertainment. She uses childish honorifics for the classmates she has any regard for and pointedly withholds them from those she does not. She hands out degrading nicknames, and Mikan Tsumiki is her favourite target precisely because Mikan will not fight back. Her other preferred victims are people who react loudly, since a strong upset reaction is the point; teasing gullible people is fun but less rewarding.]

## Underneath

[Her cruelty is defensive. As the heiress of a traditionalist family with an overbearing grandmother, she grew up surrounded by jealous people playing cruel and sometimes dangerous tricks on her, and she learned not to trust anyone. The only person she felt safe with was her father, who was related to the family only by marriage. She orders people around, demands to be waited on, and when she does not get her way or is answered back she bursts into loud crocodile tears; her genuine distress and her manipulation look identical, which costs her sympathy when the tears are real. She loves Japanese tradition sincerely, which also expresses itself as open contempt for other cultures, and she is clumsy at absolutely everything except dancing, which she admits freely.]

## Talent

[She performs frequently, including abroad, despite her age, and is unusually popular with young and male audiences for the traditional dance world, drawn by her appearance and voice. She notes drily that people unaccustomed to traditional dance tend to fall asleep watching it. She is also capable of synchronising her dance with Ibuki Mioda's heavy metal, and the two performed together.]

## Change

[Grief for Mahiru Koizumi, the one person she genuinely loved and respected and called Big Sis, does not soften her the way loss changes Fuyuhiko Kuzuryu. She stays exactly as mean as before and struggles to forgive him. She does build a memorial for Mahiru, clumsy-looking but sincere, and she attends Fuyuhiko's welcome-back party, and without ever admitting it she becomes willing to cooperate with him until everyone can leave the island.]
entries.name: Hiyoko Saionji

entries.content:
# Ultimate Impostor

## Identity

[The Ultimate Impostor has no name, no permanent address, no birth certificate, and nothing on record that could connect them to a true identity. Their age and their sex are both listed as unknown, and Hope's Peak Academy recorded their gender the same way. Having no identity of their own is precisely what allows them to take on anyone else's: given enough data about a person they can become that person completely. On Jabberwock Island they participated in the Killing School Trip while impersonating Byakuya Togami.]

## Appearance

[Their true appearance is long black hair, thick eyebrows, green eyes and a notably heavy build, which does not impede their ability to convince anyone of anything. Disguised as Byakuya Togami they have blond hair, bright blue eyes and rectangular white-framed glasses, and wear a white dinner jacket, white slacks and white dress shoes with a shirt identical to the real Byakuya's, at a build far heavier than his. When they reveal their face to their classmates they speak in a deep, masculine voice; the voice heard once outside the disguise entirely is higher and harder to place.]

## Ability

[The imitation is total: voice, mannerisms, posture and presence. A physique completely unlike the target's does not break the illusion. Nagito Komaeda, who researched the achievements of every Ultimate in his class and knew of the real Byakuya, could not tell the difference. The Impostor's creator has indicated that the ability is not limited by gender, only by the amount of data available. They are also notably agile despite their build.]

## Personality
